+## [0.60.638.0] - 2026-11-10
+
+**Atoms extracted from a world page never carry a fence row the page shows only to its owner, and `gbrain repair atom-fence-rows` finds and narrows atoms stored before.** A world page's facts table can hold rows marked `visibility: private`, and its takes table is never part of what a remote caller reads. Atom extraction, take proposals and the patterns phase read a page as a world reader sees it, so what they produce holds only world rows. Atoms an earlier version stored may still hold such a row: doctor `atom_fence_rows` counts them and names the read-only preview, and only `gbrain repair atom-fence-rows --apply --expect <hash>` makes the previewed atoms private. Nothing runs on upgrade.
+
+### Itemized changes
+
+- `src/core/cycle/extract-atoms-input.ts`: a page's extraction input is its `publicBody` (facts rows other than world and the takes fence removed); the cap, the watermark and quote verification apply to that text, on the cycle phase and the managed path alike.
+- `src/core/cycle/propose-takes.ts`: the extractor receives the page's `publicBody`, and a proposal that restates a take held by someone other than `world` is dropped before it is filed; the content hash, fence skip and dedup rows still read the stored body.
+- `src/core/cycle/patterns.ts`: reflection excerpts in the subagent prompt and the quote-grounding sources are the reflection's `publicBody`.
+- `src/core/repair/atom-fence-rows.ts` (new, registered in `repair/core.ts`, `repair/registry.ts`, `persistence/preview-approval.ts`): explicit-only, preview-bound kind; the preview lists each world atom with its source page and the row kinds and numbers it carries (never the row text) and changes nothing; the apply sets `visibility: private` on exactly the previewed set through a revision-bound put_page.
+- `src/commands/doctor/checks/atom-fence-rows.ts` (new, a host-only `WAVE_CHECKS` entry, BRAIN category): `atom_fence_rows` warns with the count per source and the preview command.
+- Docs: `docs/guides/repair.md#atom-fence-rows` (what is listed, the apply, cost), `skills/RESOLVER.md`, key-files rows in `core-cycle.md`, `hindsight.md`, `core-cycle-patterns.md` and `memory-purge.md`.
+- Tests (PGLite and Postgres): `test/extract-atoms-world-fence-rows.test.ts` (cycle phase and managed brain: prompt, atoms and a remote read of each atom hold only world rows), `test/cycle-world-fence-rows.test.ts` (propose_takes input and proposals, patterns prompt and quote grounding), `test/repair-atom-fence-rows.test.ts` (doctor finding, preview changes nothing, apply without `--expect` refuses, apply narrows exactly the previewed atoms, unmanaged and managed).
+
+## [0.60.637.0] - 2026-11-10
+
+**A file Git puts back after sync deleted its page brings the page back, and the retention purge never deletes a committed file.** On a managed brain, a commit that removed a Markdown file made sync soft-delete its page. When the same file came back (a `git revert`, switching to a branch and back, a collaborator's delete-then-restore, a file missing from disk for one working-tree sync), sync settled the path as "deleted, file unchanged" and left the page out of get, search and recall while `gbrain sync status` said synced. `gbrain pages purge-deleted --yes` then deleted the restored file from the checkout. Sync now tells a tombstone it made from a missing file apart from a person's delete and imports the file over it, so the same page comes back; a brain an older version left in that state heals on its next sync. The purge leaves a file committed at the source's last synced commit or at HEAD alone, unless a person's delete of the page never removed the file (for example because another page shared it). A page purge also stops leaving timeline text in the write journal.
+
+### Itemized changes
+
+- `src/core/persistence/sync-pass.ts`, `sync-classify.ts`: the level read marks a tombstone a managed sync deletion made (its open `sync-delete-tombstone` record or uncompacted `managed_sync_delete` receipt); once its file is back with clean committed bytes it classifies `import` (the import revives the same page row), and a `file_drift` hold an older version raised over it re-runs. A person's tombstone keeps `deleted_same` / `deleted_edited`.
+- `src/core/persistence/sync-pass-run.ts`: the selection fingerprint carries `sync_deleted_restore`, so the first sync after the upgrade reads the whole source once and brings back pages left deleted beside their file.
+- `src/core/persistence/page-prepare.ts`, `sync-markers.ts`: a retention purge of a tombstone whose file is committed at the source's `last_commit` or HEAD removes no file: a sync-made tombstone defers (`revision_conflict`) to the sync that restores it; any other is purged database-only (`write_through.skipped: committed_file`), except a person's delete that made the tombstone and never removed its file (`write_through.written: false`, for example because another live page shared it), which still has the purge finish that removal. Publication re-checks, so a file committed while the purge was prepared is kept too. A sync-made tombstone defers only while its file is on disk; off disk (working-tree mode) it is purged database-only without a deletion marker, so the file's later return imports it. An unreadable checkout counts as committed; a checkout with no commit yet does not. Repo-less sources are unchanged.
+- `src/core/persistence/page-purge.ts`: a page purge redacts the `entry` summary and source and the `bullet` text of the page's `add_timeline_entry` receipts, compacted ones included (up to 10,000 per page; past that `journal_sweep.complete` is false).
+- Tests: `test/sync-restored-file-purge.test.ts` (PGLite and Postgres), `test/sync-classify-6712.test.ts`, `test/purge-eval-fixes.test.ts`.
+

+### Atom fence rows
+
+A world atom carries the claim of a fence row its source page shows only to
+the owner when an older extraction read the whole page: a facts row whose
+`visibility` is not `world`, or a takes row whose holder is not `world`.
+Extraction now reads a page as a world reader sees it, so new atoms never
+carry such a row, but atoms already stored keep what they copied and a remote
+read returns it. `gbrain repair atom-fence-rows` finds them and, only when you
+apply it, makes them private. It is explicit-only and preview-bound, and
+nothing runs on upgrade.
+
+```bash
+gbrain doctor --only atom_fence_rows --json            # count per source; ok when none
+gbrain repair atom-fence-rows --source <id> --json     # preview: each atom, its source page, the row kinds and numbers, and a hash
+gbrain repair atom-fence-rows --source <id> --apply --expect <hash>
+```
+
+An atom is listed when it is live, page-bound (`source_slug`), stamped
+`visibility: world`, and its title, body or `source_quote` contains (case and
+whitespace folded) the claim of such a row in any fence of its live source page
+a world reader does not see (a fence quoted in a code block included), unless
+the page's world text holds the same claim too. Claims shorter than 12 characters
+are not matched. The preview names each atom with its source page and the
+rows (`facts row 2`, `takes row 1`), never the row text, and changes nothing.
+A source page stored in segments is not read: its world atoms are counted as
+`origin_unread`.
+
+The apply sets `visibility: private` on exactly the previewed set through a
+revision-bound put_page, which re-chunks and re-embeds each atom; remote reads
+and search stop returning it, local reads keep it. An atom whose revision,
+source page or matched rows changed since the preview reports
+`changed_since_preview` and is kept. `--apply` without `--expect` refuses
+with the preview and apply commands; a stale hash or another `--source`
+refuses with [`preview_changed`](#preview-changed).
+
+Cost: doctor and the preview read every world atom whose source page names a
+facts or takes fence, in pages of 500 by id, and each such source page once;
+no model is called. Doctor bounds each statement at 120 seconds and reports
+the count as unknown when one overruns. Show the user the preview before
+running the apply.
+

+/**
+ * `atom_fence_rows`: world atoms whose title, body or source_quote carries the claim of a fence row their source page
+ * shows only to the owner (repair/atom-fence-rows.ts holds the rule and the scan). A `WAVE_CHECKS` entry, host-only:
+ * `ok` when none; `warn` with the count per source and the read-only preview as fix, never a slug or row text. The
+ * apply narrows the previewed atoms to private and needs the user's agreement on that set. Each statement is bounded
+ * by PLAN_STATEMENT_MS; an overrun reports the count as unknown.
+ */
+import type { BrainEngine } from '../../../core/engine.ts';
+import type { Check } from '../../doctor.ts';
+import { agentFix } from '../check-fix.ts';
+import { findAtomFenceRows } from '../../../core/repair/atom-fence-rows.ts';
+import { PLAN_STATEMENT_MS } from '../../../core/repair/visibility.ts';
+
+const DOCS = 'docs/guides/repair.md#atom-fence-rows';
+
+export async function atomFenceRowsCheck(engine: BrainEngine, sourceIds?: string[]): Promise<Check> {
+  const name = 'atom_fence_rows';
+  try {
+    const sources = sourceIds ?? (await engine.executeRaw<{ id: string }>('SELECT id FROM sources WHERE archived IS NOT TRUE ORDER BY id')).map(row => row.id);
+    const bySource: Array<{ source_id: string; count: number }> = [];
+    let originUnread = 0;
+    for (const source of sources) {
+      const scan = await findAtomFenceRows(engine, [source], { timeoutMs: PLAN_STATEMENT_MS });
+      originUnread += scan.origin_unread;
+      if (scan.atoms.length) bySource.push({ source_id: source, count: scan.atoms.length });
+    }
+    const count = bySource.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.count, 0);
+    const details = { count, by_source: bySource, origin_unread: originUnread, repair: 'atom-fence-rows', docs: DOCS };
+    if (!count) {
+      return { name, status: 'ok', details, message: 'No world atom carries a fence row its source page shows only to the owner.' };
+    }
+    const preview = ['gbrain', 'repair', 'atom-fence-rows', '--source', bySource[0]!.source_id, '--json'];
+    return { name, status: 'warn', details,
+      message: `${count} world atom(s) carry the claim of a fence row their source page shows only to the owner, so remote callers can read it `
+        + `(${bySource.map(row => `${row.source_id}: ${row.count}`).join('; ')}). Preview them with ${preview.join(' ')} (read-only); `
+        + 'narrow the previewed set to private only after the user agrees.',
+      fix: agentFix(preview, 'Lists each atom with its source page and the fence row kinds and numbers it carries, and prints the apply command bound to that set; '
+        + 'it writes nothing. Narrowing the atoms is the user\'s call: show them the preview before running the apply.', name, { docs: DOCS }) };
+  } catch (error) {
+    const timedOut = (error as { code?: string } | null)?.code === '57014';
+    return { name, status: 'warn', details: { count: 'unknown' },
+      message: timedOut ? `The world atom scan did not finish within ${PLAN_STATEMENT_MS} ms; preview it with gbrain repair atom-fence-rows --source <id>. Health is unknown.`
+        : `World atoms could not be checked for owner-only fence rows: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}. Health is unknown.` };
+  }
+}

+/**
+ * GST-2201: whether a page's file is committed at its source's `last_commit` or at the checkout's HEAD (a commit sync has not
+ * read yet), so a retention purge must not remove it. False on an unmanaged brain, for a source with no worktree binding (a
+ * repo-less brain), a company-brain source or a checkout with no commit yet; a checkout or tree that cannot be read counts as committed (fail closed: the
+ * file stays).
+ */
+export async function originCommitted(engine: BrainEngine, sourceId: string, sourcePath: string | null | undefined): Promise<boolean> {
+  if (!sourcePath || !await managedPersistenceEnabled(engine)) return false;
+  const [source] = await engine.executeRaw<{ last_commit: string | null; config: Record<string, unknown> | null }>('SELECT last_commit, config FROM sources WHERE id=$1', [sourceId]);
+  if (!source || companyBrainProfile(source.config) !== null) return false;
+  const binding = await getWorktreeBinding(engine, sourceId);
+  if (!binding) return false;
+  const root = binding.local_path ? resolve(binding.local_path, binding.relative_path) : null;
+  const origin = originGitPaths(root, typeof source.config?.slug_root_mode === 'string' ? source.config.slug_root_mode : null, sourcePath);
+  if (!origin) return true;
+  if (originInTree(origin, source.last_commit)) return true;
+  const head = hardenedGitSync(origin.gitRoot, ['rev-parse', '--verify', '--quiet', 'HEAD^{commit}'], TREE_READ_LIMITS);
+  if (!head.ok) return !(head.reason === 'exit' && head.status === 1);
+  return originInTree(origin, head.stdout.toString('utf8').trim());
+}

+/**
+ * `gbrain repair atom-fence-rows`: world atoms that carry text of a fence row
+ * their source page shows only to the owner.
+ *
+ * Atoms extracted before the extraction input was the page as a world reader
+ * sees it (extract-atoms-input.ts) could copy such a row into their title, body
+ * or verified `source_quote`, and a world atom serves it to remote callers. A
+ * live page-bound atom stamped `visibility: world` is listed when its title,
+ * body or source_quote contains (case and whitespace folded) the claim of a
+ * facts row of its live source page whose visibility is not world, or of a
+ * takes row whose holder is not world, unless the page's world text
+ * (`publicBody`) holds the same claim too. Claims under MIN_CLAIM_CHARS are
+ * not matched. A source page stored in segments is not read; its atoms are
+ * counted as `origin_unread`.
+ *
+ * Explicit-only and preview-bound: the preview lists each atom with its source
+ * page and the row kinds and numbers it carries, never the row text, and
+ * changes nothing; `--apply --expect <hash>` narrows exactly that set to
+ * `visibility: private` through a revision-bound put_page (re-chunked and
+ * re-embedded by its publication). An atom whose revision, source page or
+ * matched rows changed since reports `changed_since_preview` and is kept.
+ * The same scan backs doctor's `atom_fence_rows` check.
+ */
+import type { BrainEngine } from '../engine.ts';
+import { FACTS_FENCE_BEGIN, FACTS_FENCE_END, parseFactsFence } from '../facts-fence.ts';
+import { TAKES_FENCE_BEGIN, TAKES_FENCE_END, parseTakesFence } from '../takes-fence.ts';
+import { protectedRegions } from '../fence-scan.ts';
+import { publicBody } from '../mentions/aliases.ts';
+import { serializePageToMarkdown } from '../markdown.ts';
+import { OperationError } from '../ops/contract.ts';
+import { submitPageMutation } from '../persistence/page-mutations.ts';
+import { clearApprovedSet, loadApprovedSet, previewChangedError, previewHash, saveApprovedSet } from '../persistence/preview-approval.ts';
+import { afterCursor, repairRequestId, type RepairHandler, type RepairItem, type RepairItemOutcome, type RepairPlan, type RepairScope } from './core.ts';
+
+export const MIN_CLAIM_CHARS = 12;
+const BATCH = 500;
+
+export interface HiddenRowMatch { kind: 'facts' | 'takes'; row: number }
+
+export interface AtomFenceRow {
+  id: number;
+  source_id: string;
+  slug: string;
+  revision: string;
+  origin_slug: string;
+  origin_id: number;
+  origin_hash: string | null;
+  rows: HiddenRowMatch[];
+}
+
+interface ScanOptions { atomId?: number; timeoutMs?: number }
+
+const fold = (text: string) => text.replace(/~~/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().toLowerCase();
+
+/** Every fence publicBody removes (one quoted in a code block and an unterminated tail included), each closed for parsing. */
+function fenceRegions(body: string, begin: string, end: string): string[] {
+  const { regions, truncatedAt } = protectedRegions(body, [{ begin, end }]);
+  const texts = regions.map(region => body.slice(region.start, region.end));
+  return truncatedAt === -1 ? texts : [...texts, `${body.slice(truncatedAt)}\n${end}`];
+}
+
+/** Claims of the page's facts rows other than world and takes rows held by someone other than world, absent from its world text. */
+function hiddenRows(body: string): Array<HiddenRowMatch & { claim: string }> {
+  const world = fold(publicBody(body));
+  const rows = [
+    ...fenceRegions(body, FACTS_FENCE_BEGIN, FACTS_FENCE_END).flatMap(text => parseFactsFence(text).facts)
+      .filter(f => f.visibility !== 'world').map(f => ({ kind: 'facts' as const, row: f.rowNum, claim: fold(f.claim) })),
+    ...fenceRegions(body, TAKES_FENCE_BEGIN, TAKES_FENCE_END).flatMap(text => parseTakesFence(text).takes)
+      .filter(t => t.holder !== 'world').map(t => ({ kind: 'takes' as const, row: t.rowNum, claim: fold(t.claim) })),
+  ];
+  return rows.filter(r => r.claim.length >= MIN_CLAIM_CHARS && !world.includes(r.claim));
+}
+
+/**
+ * World atoms of these sources that carry a hidden row of their source page, in id order, and the number of world
+ * atoms whose source page is stored in segments (not read). One keyset-paged pass over the sources' world atoms whose
+ * source page names a facts or takes fence, plus one read of each such page.
+ */
+export async function findAtomFenceRows(engine: BrainEngine, sourceIds: string[], opts: ScanOptions = {}): Promise<{ atoms: AtomFenceRow[]; origin_unread: number }> {
+  const atoms: AtomFenceRow[] = [];
+  const origins = new Map<number, Array<HiddenRowMatch & { claim: string }>>();
+  let originUnread = 0;
+  let after = 0;
+  for (;;) {
+    const rows = await engine.executeRaw<{ id: number; source_id: string; slug: string; revision: string; text: string; origin_id: number; origin_slug: string;
+      origin_hash: string | null; origin_unread: boolean }>(
+      `SELECT a.id, a.source_id, a.slug, a.knowledge_revision::text AS revision,
+              concat_ws(E'\\n', a.title, a.compiled_truth, a.frontmatter->>'source_quote') AS text,
+              o.id AS origin_id, o.slug AS origin_slug, o.content_hash AS origin_hash, o.compiled_truth IS NULL AS origin_unread
+         FROM pages a
+         JOIN pages o ON o.source_id=a.source_id AND o.slug=a.frontmatter->>'source_slug' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
+        WHERE a.source_id=ANY($1::text[]) AND a.type='atom' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.frontmatter->>'visibility'='world'
+          AND ($2::int IS NULL OR a.id=$2::int) AND a.id>$3
+          AND (o.compiled_truth IS NULL OR strpos(o.compiled_truth, 'gbrain:facts:begin')>0 OR strpos(o.compiled_truth, 'gbrain:takes:begin')>0)
+        ORDER BY a.id LIMIT $4`, [sourceIds, opts.atomId ?? null, after, BATCH], opts.timeoutMs ? { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs } : undefined);
+    if (!rows.length) break;
+    const unseen = [...new Set(rows.filter(r => !r.origin_unread).map(r => Number(r.origin_id)))].filter(id => !origins.has(id));
+    if (unseen.length) {
+      const bodies = await engine.executeRaw<{ id: number; body: string | null }>('SELECT id, compiled_truth AS body FROM pages WHERE id=ANY($1::int[])',
+        [unseen], opts.timeoutMs ? { timeoutMs: opts.timeoutMs } : undefined);
+      for (const page of bodies) origins.set(Number(page.id), hiddenRows(page.body ?? ''));
+    }
+    for (const row of rows) {
+      if (row.origin_unread) { originUnread++; continue; }
+      const text = fold(row.text ?? '');
+      const matched = (origins.get(Number(row.origin_id)) ?? []).filter(hidden => text.includes(hidden.claim)).map(({ kind, row: n }) => ({ kind, row: n }));
+      if (matched.length) atoms.push({ id: Number(row.id), source_id: row.source_id, slug: row.slug, revision: row.revision, origin_slug: row.origin_slug,
+        origin_id: Number(row.origin_id), origin_hash: row.origin_hash, rows: matched });
+    }
+    after = Number(rows.at(-1)!.id);
+    if (rows.length < BATCH) break;
+  }
+  return { atoms, origin_unread: originUnread };
+}
+
+export function atomFenceRowsPreviewCommand(sourceIds: string[]): string {
+  return `gbrain repair atom-fence-rows${sourceIds.length === 1 ? ` --source ${sourceIds[0]}` : ''}`;
+}
+
+interface AtomFenceRowItem extends RepairItem { atom: AtomFenceRow; hash: string; last: boolean }
+
+interface ApprovedAtom extends AtomFenceRow { selection: string[] }
+
+const rowLabel = (atom: AtomFenceRow) => atom.rows.map(r => `${r.kind} row ${r.row}`).join(', ');
+
+const sameAtom = (live: AtomFenceRow | undefined, approved: AtomFenceRow) => !!live
+  && (['id', 'source_id', 'slug', 'revision', 'origin_slug', 'origin_id', 'origin_hash'] as const).every(field => live[field] === approved[field])
+  && rowLabel(live) === rowLabel(approved);
+
+function item(atom: AtomFenceRow, hash: string, last: boolean): AtomFenceRowItem {
+  return { cursor: { phase: 1, id: atom.id }, source_id: atom.source_id, slug: atom.slug, chars: 0,
+    action: 'narrow:private', change: { from: 'world', to: 'private' }, atom, hash, last };
+}
+
+async function hashParts(engine: BrainEngine, scope: RepairScope, atoms: AtomFenceRow[]) {
+  const sources = await engine.executeRaw<{ id: string; incarnation: string }>(
+    'SELECT id, incarnation::text AS incarnation FROM sources WHERE id=ANY($1::text[]) ORDER BY id', [scope.source_ids]);
+  return { kind: 'atom-fence-rows-v1', brain_id: scope.brain_id, sources, selection: { source_ids: scope.source_ids }, atoms };
+}
+
+export const atomFenceRowsRepair: RepairHandler = {
+  kind: 'atom-fence-rows',
+  async plan(engine, scope, after, opts): Promise<RepairPlan> {
+    const command = atomFenceRowsPreviewCommand(scope.source_ids);
+    if (!opts?.apply) {
+      const { atoms, origin_unread } = await findAtomFenceRows(engine, scope.source_ids);
+      const hash = previewHash(await hashParts(engine, scope, atoms));
+      if (atoms.length) await saveApprovedSet<ApprovedAtom>(engine, { command: 'atom-fence-rows', hash }, atoms.map(atom => ({ ...atom, selection: scope.source_ids })));
+      return { items: atoms.map((atom, index) => item(atom, hash, index === atoms.length - 1)), preview_hash: hash,
+        residuals: { origin_unread },
+        listing: atoms.map(atom => ({ item: `${atom.source_id}:${atom.slug}`, class: [...new Set(atom.rows.map(r => r.kind))].join('+'),
+          detail: `source page ${atom.origin_slug}: ${rowLabel(atom)}` })) };
+    }
+    if (!opts.expect) {
+      throw new OperationError('invalid_params', 'gbrain repair atom-fence-rows --apply narrows only the set a preview printed.',
+        `Preview first: ${command} — then run the apply command it prints: ${command} --apply --expect <preview-hash>`,
+        'docs/guides/repair.md#atom-fence-rows');
+    }
+    const approved = await loadApprovedSet<ApprovedAtom>(engine, { command: 'atom-fence-rows', hash: opts.expect, previewCommand: command,
+      emptyHash: async () => previewHash(await hashParts(engine, scope, [])) });
+    if (approved.items.some(atom => JSON.stringify(atom.selection) !== JSON.stringify(scope.source_ids))) throw previewChangedError(opts.expect, command);
+    const items = approved.items.map(({ selection: _selection, ...atom }, index) => item(atom, opts.expect!, index === approved.items.length - 1));
+    return { items: items.filter(entry => afterCursor(entry.cursor, after)), preview_hash: opts.expect, residuals: {} };
+  },
+  async apply(ctx, entry): Promise<RepairItemOutcome> {
+    const { atom, hash, last } = entry as AtomFenceRowItem;
+    try {
+      const changed = (reason: string): RepairItemOutcome => ({ applied: false, outcome: 'changed_since_preview', reason });
+      if (!sameAtom((await findAtomFenceRows(ctx.engine, [atom.source_id], { atomId: atom.id })).atoms[0], atom)) return changed('the atom, its source page or the rows it carries changed');
+      const snapshot = await ctx.engine.readPageSnapshot(atom.slug, { sourceId: atom.source_id });
+      if (!snapshot || Number(snapshot.page.id) !== atom.id || snapshot.revision !== atom.revision) return changed('the atom changed');
+      const page = { ...snapshot.page, frontmatter: { ...snapshot.page.frontmatter, visibility: 'private' } };
+      await submitPageMutation(ctx, { operation: 'put_page', params: { slug: atom.slug, source_id: atom.source_id,
+        content: serializePageToMarkdown(page, snapshot.tags), expected_revision: snapshot.revision,
+        request_id: await repairRequestId(ctx, 'atom-fence-rows', entry, snapshot.revision) } });
+      return { applied: true, outcome: 'narrowed' };
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (error instanceof OperationError && ['revision_conflict', 'page_not_found', 'page_identity_changed'].includes(error.code)) {
+        return { applied: false, outcome: 'changed_since_preview', reason: error.message };
+      }
+      throw error;
+    } finally {
+      if (last) await clearApprovedSet(ctx.engine, { command: 'atom-fence-rows', hash });
+    }
+  },
+};

+/**
+ * Dream phases that read page bodies never carry a non-world fence row into
+ * what they produce.
+ *
+ * propose_takes sends a page's prose to the extractor model and files what it
+ * returns as take proposals; patterns sends each reflection's excerpt to its
+ * subagent, which writes world pattern pages, and grounds those pages' quotes
+ * against the reflections. Each reads the page as a world reader sees it
+ * (facts rows other than world and the takes fence removed), so a hidden row
+ * never reaches the extractor, a proposal, the subagent prompt, or a quote
+ * certified as verified. PGLite and Postgres.
+ */

+    });

+  });

diff --git a/test/extract-atoms-world-fence-rows.test.ts b/test/extract-atoms-world-fence-rows.test.ts

+/**
+ * Atoms extracted from a world page never carry a non-world fence row.
+ *
+ * A world page's facts fence may hold rows marked `visibility: private`, and its
+ * takes fence is never part of the page text a remote caller reads. The
+ * extraction input is the page as a world reader sees it (the facts fence keeps
+ * only world rows, the takes fence is dropped), so neither the model prompt nor
+ * the atom it returns (title, body, verified source_quote) can hold a hidden
+ * row, and a remote get_page of the atom returns none of it.
+ *
+ * The stub model copies every fence row it is shown into an atom, so a hidden
+ * row that reached the prompt would reach the atom. PGLite and Postgres, the
+ * unmanaged cycle phase (page discovery) and a managed brain (origin
+ * publication through the coordinator).
+ */
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
+import type { BrainEngine } from '../src/core/engine.ts';
+import { PGLiteEngine } from '../src/core/pglite-engine.ts';
+import type { ChatOpts, ChatResult } from '../src/core/ai/gateway.ts';
+import { runPhaseExtractAtoms } from '../src/core/cycle/extract-atoms.ts';
+import { dispatchToolCall } from '../src/mcp/dispatch.ts';
+import { disposePersistenceConsumer } from '../src/core/persistence/service.ts';
+import { isolatedPersistencePostgres } from './helpers/persistence-postgres.ts';
+import { managedBrain } from './helpers/managed-brain.ts';
+import { requirePostgresTestDatabase, testBackends } from './helpers/test-backends.ts';
+import { HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW, PRIVATE_ROW, WORLD_ROW, WORLD_PAGE_BODY as BODY } from './helpers/world-fence-page.ts';
+
+const SLUG = 'notes/launch-review';
+
+/** A model that turns every fence row it is shown into an atom quoting that row verbatim. */
+function copyingChat() {
+  const prompts: string[] = [];
+  const chat = async (opts: ChatOpts): Promise<ChatResult> => {
+    const last = opts.messages[opts.messages.length - 1];
+    const prompt = typeof last.content === 'string' ? last.content : JSON.stringify(last.content);
+    prompts.push(prompt);
+    const rows = [WORLD_ROW, PRIVATE_ROW, HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW].filter(row => prompt.includes(row));
+    const atoms = [
+      { title: 'Measure every launch', body: 'Measure every launch against clear exit criteria.', atom_type: 'insight',
+        source_quote: 'the team measures every launch against clear exit criteria' },
+      ...rows.map((row, i) => ({ title: `Row ${i + 1}: ${row}`, body: `Recorded on the page: ${row}.`, atom_type: 'insight', source_quote: row })),
+    ];
+    const text = JSON.stringify(atoms);
+    return { text, blocks: [{ type: 'text', text }], stopReason: 'end',
+      usage: { input_tokens: 10, output_tokens: 10, cache_read_tokens: 0, cache_creation_tokens: 0 }, model: 'anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5', providerId: 'anthropic' };
+  };
+  return { prompts, chat };
+}
+
+const atomsOf = (engine: BrainEngine, sourceId: string) =>
+  engine.executeRaw<{ slug: string; title: string; compiled_truth: string; visibility: string | null; source_quote: string | null }>(
+    `SELECT slug, title, compiled_truth, frontmatter->>'visibility' AS visibility, frontmatter->>'source_quote' AS source_quote
+       FROM pages WHERE source_id=$1 AND type='atom' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND frontmatter->>'source_slug'=$2 ORDER BY slug`, [sourceId, SLUG]);
+
+async function remoteGet(engine: BrainEngine, sourceId: string, slug: string): Promise<string> {
+  const out = await dispatchToolCall(engine, 'get_page', { slug }, { remote: true, transport: 'stdio', sourceId, takesHoldersAllowList: ['world'] });
+  return out.content.map(c => c.text).join('\n');
+}
+
+async function expectOnlyWorldRows(engine: BrainEngine, sourceId: string, prompts: string[], backend: string) {
+  const atoms = await atomsOf(engine, sourceId);
+  expect(atoms.length, backend).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+  for (const atom of atoms) {
+    expect(atom.visibility, backend).toBe('world');
+    const remote = await remoteGet(engine, sourceId, atom.slug);
+    expect(remote, backend).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+    expect(remote, backend).not.toContain(HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW);
+    for (const text of [atom.title, atom.compiled_truth, atom.source_quote ?? '']) {
+      expect(text, backend).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+      expect(text, backend).not.toContain(HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW);
+    }
+  }
+  expect(atoms.some(atom => atom.source_quote === WORLD_ROW), backend).toBe(true);
+  expect(prompts.length, backend).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+  for (const prompt of prompts) {
+    expect(prompt, backend).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+    expect(prompt, backend).not.toContain(HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW);
+    expect(prompt, backend).toContain(WORLD_ROW);
+  }
+  // Control: the source page itself reads back remotely with its world row and without the hidden ones.
+  const source = await remoteGet(engine, sourceId, SLUG);
+  expect(source, backend).toContain(WORLD_ROW);
+  expect(source, backend).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+}
+
+describe('atoms extracted from a world page never carry a non-world fence row', () => {
+  const engines: Array<{ backend: string; engine: BrainEngine }> = [];
+  let closePostgres: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined;
+
+  beforeAll(async () => {
+    for (const backend of testBackends()) {
+      if (backend === 'pglite') {
+        const engine = new PGLiteEngine();
+        await engine.connect({});
+        await engine.initSchema();
+        engines.push({ backend, engine });
+      } else {
+        const isolated = await isolatedPersistencePostgres(requirePostgresTestDatabase());
+        engines.push({ backend, engine: isolated.engine });
+        closePostgres = isolated.close;
+      }
+    }
+  }, 120_000);
+  afterAll(async () => {
+    for (const { engine } of engines) { await disposePersistenceConsumer(engine); await engine.disconnect(); }
+    await closePostgres?.();
+  });
+
+  test('cycle phase: the prompt, the atoms and a remote read of each atom hold only world rows', async () => {
+    for (const { backend, engine } of engines) {
+      const sourceId = `world-rows-${backend}`;
+      await engine.executeRaw('INSERT INTO sources(id,name) VALUES($1,$1)', [sourceId]);
+      await engine.putPage(SLUG, { type: 'note', title: 'Launch review', compiled_truth: BODY, timeline: '' }, { sourceId });
+      const { prompts, chat } = copyingChat();
+      const result = await runPhaseExtractAtoms(engine, { sourceId, _chat: chat, _transcripts: [] });
+      expect(result.status, backend).toBe('ok');
+      await expectOnlyWorldRows(engine, sourceId, prompts, backend);
+    }
+  }, 120_000);
+
+  test('managed brain: the published atoms hold only world rows', async () => {
+    for (const backend of testBackends()) {
+      const databaseUrl = backend === 'postgres' ? requirePostgresTestDatabase() : undefined;
+      await managedBrain(async ({ engine }) => {
+        const page = (await engine.getPage(SLUG, { sourceId: 'default' }))!;
+        const { prompts, chat } = copyingChat();
+        const result = await runPhaseExtractAtoms(engine, { sourceId: 'default', _chat: chat, _transcripts: [],
+          _pages: [{ slug: SLUG, content: page.compiled_truth, contentHash: page.content_hash! }] });
+        await disposePersistenceConsumer(engine);
+        expect(result.status, backend).toBe('ok');
+        await expectOnlyWorldRows(engine, 'default', prompts, backend);
+      }, { databaseUrl, setup: async ({ engine }) => {
+        await engine.putPage(SLUG, { type: 'note', title: 'Launch review', compiled_truth: BODY, timeline: '' }, { sourceId: 'default' });
+      } });
+    }
+  }, 180_000);
+});

+// TC-FCB-003 / SC-FCB-003
+import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, beforeEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
+import { PGLiteEngine } from '../src/core/pglite-engine.ts';
+import { operationsByName, type OperationContext } from '../src/core/operations.ts';
+import { captureRetrievalMeta, formatResult, resetRetrievalMetaForTests } from '../src/cli/main.ts';
+import { DEFAULT_CLI_OPTIONS, setCliOptions } from '../src/core/cli-options.ts';
+import { installFixtureChunks } from './helpers/page-projection.ts';
+import { resetPgliteState } from './helpers/reset-pglite.ts';
+import type { SearchResult } from '../src/core/types.ts';
+
+let engine: PGLiteEngine;
+
+beforeAll(async () => {
+  engine = new PGLiteEngine();
+  await engine.connect({});
+  await engine.initSchema();
+});
+afterAll(async () => { await engine.disconnect(); });
+beforeEach(async () => { await resetPgliteState(engine); });
+afterEach(() => {
+  setCliOptions({ ...DEFAULT_CLI_OPTIONS });
+  resetRetrievalMetaForTests();
+});
+
+function contextWithMeta(): { ctx: OperationContext; meta: Record<string, unknown> } {
+  const meta: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+  const ctx = {
+    engine,
+    remote: false,
+    sourceId: 'default',
+    emitResponseMeta: (key: string, value: unknown) => { meta[key] = value; },
+  } as unknown as OperationContext;
+  return { ctx, meta };
+}
+
+async function seedNote(): Promise<void> {
+  const text = 'The synthetic quillmarsh ledger records the harbor survey.';
+  await engine.putPage('notes/quillmarsh-ledger', {
+    type: 'note', title: 'Quillmarsh ledger', compiled_truth: text,
+  });
+  await installFixtureChunks(engine, 'notes/quillmarsh-ledger', [
+    { chunk_index: 0, chunk_text: text, chunk_source: 'compiled_truth' },
+  ]);
+}
+
+describe('query.trace retrieval diagnostics', () => {
+  test('trace on preserves the complete emitted retrieval metadata', async () => {
+    await seedNote();
+    const { ctx, meta } = contextWithMeta();
+    const out = await operationsByName.query.handler(ctx, {
+      query: 'quillmarsh ledger',
+      expand: false,
+      trace: true,
+      return_unit: 'page',
+      token_budget: 600,
+      explain_target: 'notes/quillmarsh-ledger',
+    }) as { results: Array<{ slug: string }>; trace: { retrieval?: Record<string, unknown> } };
+
+    expect(out.results.map(row => row.slug)).toContain('notes/quillmarsh-ledger');
+    expect(out.trace.retrieval).toEqual(meta.retrieval as Record<string, unknown>);
+    expect(out.trace.retrieval).toMatchObject({
+      returned_count: out.results.length,
+      retrieved_count: out.results.length,
+      delivery: expect.any(Object),
+      crag: expect.any(Object),
+      explain_target: { state: 'retrieved', code: 'target_returned' },
+      timings: { total_ms: expect.any(Number) },
+    });
+  }, 60_000);
+
+  test('trace off preserves the upstream result array', async () => {
+    await seedNote();
+    const { ctx, meta } = contextWithMeta();
+    const out = await operationsByName.query.handler(ctx, {
+      query: 'quillmarsh ledger', expand: false,
+    }) as Array<{ slug: string }>;
+
+    expect(Array.isArray(out)).toBe(true);
+    expect(out.map(row => row.slug)).toContain('notes/quillmarsh-ledger');
+    expect(meta.retrieval).toMatchObject({ returned_count: out.length });
+  }, 60_000);
+
+  test('empty trace result preserves envelope and diagnostics', async () => {
+    const { ctx, meta } = contextWithMeta();
+    const out = await operationsByName.query.handler(ctx, {
+      query: 'zxqv-no-such-page', expand: false, trace: true,
+    }) as { results: unknown[]; trace: { retrieval?: Record<string, unknown> } };
+
+    expect(out.results).toEqual([]);
+    expect(out.trace.retrieval).toEqual(meta.retrieval as Record<string, unknown>);
+    expect(out.trace.retrieval).toMatchObject({ returned_count: 0, retrieved_count: 0 });
+  }, 60_000);
+
+  test('CLI JSON preserves trace retrieval metadata', () => {
+    const retrieval = {
+      returned_count: 1,
+      retrieved_count: 1,
+      delivery: { unit: 'page' },
+      degraded: [{ stage: 'embed_unavailable' }],
+      explain_target: { state: 'retrieved', code: 'target_returned' },
+      page_cap: { cap: 3, kept_pages: 3, dropped_pages: 2 },
+      timings: { total_ms: 12, stages_ms: { response: 2 } },
+    };
+    const row = { slug: 'notes/a', score: 1, chunk_text: 'x' } as SearchResult;
+    captureRetrievalMeta('retrieval', retrieval);
+    const doc = JSON.parse(formatResult('query', {
+      results: [row], trace: { total_ms: 12, retrieval },
+    }, { json: true }));
+    expect(doc.results).toEqual([row]);
+    expect(doc.trace.retrieval).toEqual(retrieval);
+  });
+});

+/**
+ * `gbrain repair atom-fence-rows` and doctor's `atom_fence_rows`, on PGLite and Postgres.
+ *
+ * World atoms an earlier extraction produced from the whole page can carry the claim of a facts row whose visibility
+ * is not world, or of a takes row held by someone other than world, and a remote read of the atom returns it. Doctor
+ * counts them per source and names the read-only preview; the preview lists them (slug, source page, row kind and
+ * number, never the row text) and changes nothing; only --apply --expect <hash> narrows exactly that set to private.
+ */
+import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test';
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
+import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
+import { join } from 'node:path';
+import type { BrainEngine } from '../src/core/engine.ts';
+import { configureGateway, resetGateway } from '../src/core/ai/gateway.ts';
+import { PGLiteEngine } from '../src/core/pglite-engine.ts';
+import { OperationError } from '../src/core/ops/contract.ts';
+import { runRepairCommand } from '../src/commands/repair.ts';
+import { atomFenceRowsCheck } from '../src/commands/doctor/checks/atom-fence-rows.ts';
+import { WAVE_CHECKS } from '../src/commands/doctor/wave-checks.ts';
+import { dispatchToolCall } from '../src/mcp/dispatch.ts';
+import { disposePersistenceConsumer } from '../src/core/persistence/service.ts';
+import { isolatedPersistencePostgres } from './helpers/persistence-postgres.ts';
+import { requirePostgresTestDatabase, testBackends } from './helpers/test-backends.ts';
+import { withEnv } from './helpers/with-env.ts';
+import { managedBrain } from './helpers/managed-brain.ts';
+import { FENCES, HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW, PRIVATE_ROW, WORLD_PAGE_BODY, WORLD_ROW } from './helpers/world-fence-page.ts';
+
+interface RepairJson { results: Array<{ affected: number; residuals: Record<string, number>; apply_command: string; applied: number; skipped: number;
+  listing?: Array<{ item: string; class: string; detail?: string }>; outcomes?: Record<string, number> }> }
+
+const ORIGIN = 'notes/launch-review';
+const CARRIES_FACT = 'atoms/2026-01-01/renewal-terms';
+const CARRIES_TAKE = 'atoms/2026-01-01/launch-move';
+const CLEAN = 'atoms/2026-01-01/launch-checklist';
+const ALREADY_PRIVATE = 'atoms/2026-01-01/renewal-terms-private';
+
+test('atom_fence_rows is a host-only wave check that names the atom-fence-rows repair', () => {
+  const spec = WAVE_CHECKS.find(check => check.id === 'atom_fence_rows');
+  expect(spec).toMatchObject({ resolution: 'repair', registration: 'wave' });
+  expect(spec!.hostOnly).toBeTruthy();
+});
+
+for (const kind of testBackends()) {
+  describe(`gbrain repair atom-fence-rows (${kind})`, () => {
+    let engine: BrainEngine;
+    let close: (() => Promise<void>) | undefined;
+    let sourceId: string;
+    const home = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'gbrain-repair-atom-fence-rows-'));
+
+    const putAtom = (slug: string, body: string, frontmatter: Record<string, unknown>) =>
+      engine.putPage(slug, { type: 'atom', title: slug.split('/').at(-1)!, compiled_truth: body,
+        frontmatter: { type: 'atom', atom_type: 'insight', source_slug: ORIGIN, source_hash: 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', visibility: 'world', dream_generated: true,
+          extracted_by: 'extract_atoms-v0.41.2.1', ...frontmatter } }, { sourceId });
+
+    beforeAll(async () => {
+      configureGateway({ embedding_model: 'openai:text-embedding-3-large', embedding_dimensions: 1536, env: {} });
+      if (kind === 'postgres') ({ engine, close } = await isolatedPersistencePostgres(requirePostgresTestDatabase()));
+      else { const pglite = new PGLiteEngine(); await pglite.connect({}); await pglite.initSchema(); engine = pglite; }
+      await engine.executeRaw('UPDATE persistence_brain SET enabled=false WHERE singleton=1');
+      sourceId = `fence-rows-${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
+      await engine.executeRaw('INSERT INTO sources(id,name) VALUES($1,$1)', [sourceId]);
+      await engine.putPage(ORIGIN, { type: 'note', title: 'Launch review', compiled_truth: WORLD_PAGE_BODY, timeline: '' }, { sourceId });
+      await putAtom(CARRIES_FACT, `Recorded on the page: ${PRIVATE_ROW}.`, {});
+      await putAtom(CARRIES_TAKE, 'A launch decision was recorded.', { source_quote: HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW });
+      await putAtom(CLEAN, `Recorded on the page: ${WORLD_ROW}.`, { source_quote: WORLD_ROW });
+      await putAtom(ALREADY_PRIVATE, `Recorded on the page: ${PRIVATE_ROW}.`, { visibility: 'private' });
+    }, 120_000);
+    afterAll(async () => {
+      await disposePersistenceConsumer(engine);
+      if (close) await close(); else await engine.disconnect();
+      resetGateway();
+      rmSync(home, { recursive: true, force: true });
+    });
+
+    const repair = async (args: string[]): Promise<RepairJson> => {
+      const lines: string[] = [];
+      const original = console.log;
+      console.log = (...parts: unknown[]) => { lines.push(parts.map(String).join(' ')); };
+      try { await withEnv({ GBRAIN_HOME: home }, () => runRepairCommand(engine, ['atom-fence-rows', '--source', sourceId, ...args, '--json'])); } finally { console.log = original; }
+      return JSON.parse(lines.join('\n')) as RepairJson;
+    };
+    const atoms = () => engine.executeRaw<{ slug: string; visibility: string; revision: string }>(
+      `SELECT slug, frontmatter->>'visibility' AS visibility, knowledge_revision::text AS revision FROM pages WHERE source_id=$1 AND type='atom' ORDER BY slug`, [sourceId]);
+    const remoteGet = async (slug: string) => {
+      try {
+        const out = await dispatchToolCall(engine, 'get_page', { slug }, { remote: true, transport: 'stdio', sourceId, takesHoldersAllowList: ['world'] });
+        return out.content.map(c => c.text).join('\n');
+      } catch (error) { return String(error); }
+    };
+
+    test('doctor warns with the count and the preview command, the preview lists exactly the carrying atoms and changes nothing, the apply narrows them', async () => {
+      expect(await remoteGet(CARRIES_FACT)).toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+
+      const finding = await atomFenceRowsCheck(engine, [sourceId]);
+      expect(finding.status).toBe('warn');
+      expect(finding.details).toMatchObject({ count: 2, repair: 'atom-fence-rows' });
+      expect(finding.message).toContain(`gbrain repair atom-fence-rows --source ${sourceId} --json`);
+      expect(JSON.stringify(finding)).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+      expect(JSON.stringify(finding)).not.toContain(CARRIES_FACT);
+
+      const before = await atoms();
+      const preview = await repair([]);
+      const result = preview.results[0]!;
+      expect(result.listing!.map(row => ({ item: row.item, class: row.class, detail: row.detail })).sort((a, b) => a.item.localeCompare(b.item))).toEqual([
+        { item: `${sourceId}:${CARRIES_TAKE}`, class: 'takes', detail: `source page ${ORIGIN}: takes row 1` },
+        { item: `${sourceId}:${CARRIES_FACT}`, class: 'facts', detail: `source page ${ORIGIN}: facts row 2` },
+      ].sort((a, b) => a.item.localeCompare(b.item)));
+      expect(JSON.stringify(preview)).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+      expect(JSON.stringify(preview)).not.toContain(HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW);
+      expect(await atoms()).toEqual(before);
+
+      const unbound = await withEnv({ GBRAIN_HOME: home }, () => runRepairCommand(engine, ['atom-fence-rows', '--source', sourceId, '--apply', '--json']))
+        .then(() => null, (error: unknown) => error);
+      expect(unbound).toBeInstanceOf(OperationError);
+      expect(await atoms()).toEqual(before);
+
+      const hash = result.apply_command.match(/--expect ([0-9a-f]+)/)![1]!;
+      const applied = (await repair(['--apply', '--expect', hash])).results[0]!;
+      expect(applied.applied).toBe(2);
+      expect(applied.outcomes).toMatchObject({ narrowed: 2 });
+      const after = Object.fromEntries((await atoms()).map(row => [row.slug, row.visibility]));
+      expect(after).toEqual({ [CARRIES_FACT]: 'private', [CARRIES_TAKE]: 'private', [CLEAN]: 'world', [ALREADY_PRIVATE]: 'private' });
+      expect(await remoteGet(CARRIES_FACT)).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+      expect(await remoteGet(CARRIES_TAKE)).not.toContain(HIDDEN_TAKE_ROW);
+      expect(await remoteGet(CLEAN)).toContain(WORLD_ROW);
+
+      expect((await atomFenceRowsCheck(engine, [sourceId])).status).toBe('ok');
+      expect((await repair([])).results[0]!.listing ?? []).toEqual([]);
+    }, 120_000);
+
+    test('a fence quoted in a code block counts as hidden, as it does for a world reader', async () => {
+      const quotedOrigin = 'notes/launch-review-quoted';
+      const quotedAtom = 'atoms/2026-01-01/renewal-terms-quoted';
+      await engine.putPage(quotedOrigin, { type: 'note', title: 'Launch review quoted', compiled_truth: `# Launch review\n\n\`\`\`markdown\n${FENCES}\`\`\`\n`, timeline: '' }, { sourceId });
+      await putAtom(quotedAtom, `Recorded on the page: ${PRIVATE_ROW}.`, { source_slug: quotedOrigin });
+      expect(await remoteGet(quotedOrigin)).not.toContain(PRIVATE_ROW);
+
+      const finding = await atomFenceRowsCheck(engine, [sourceId]);
+      expect(finding.status).toBe('warn');
+      expect(finding.details).toMatchObject({ count: 1 });
+      const listing = (await repair([])).results[0]!.listing!;
+      expect(listing.map(row => ({ item: row.item, class: row.class, detail: row.detail }))).toEqual([
+        { item: `${sourceId}:${quotedAtom}`, class: 'facts', detail: `source page ${quotedOrigin}: facts row 2` },
+      ]);
+    }, 120_000);
+    test('managed brain: the apply narrows the previewed atom through the coordinator', async () => {
+      await managedBrain(async ({ engine: brain }) => {
+        const run = async (args: string[]): Promise<RepairJson> => {
+          const lines: string[] = [];
+          const original = console.log;
+          console.log = (...parts: unknown[]) => { lines.push(parts.map(String).join(' ')); };
+          try { await runRepairCommand(brain, ['atom-fence-rows', '--source', 'default', ...args, '--json']); } finally { console.log = original; }
+          return JSON.parse(lines.join('\n')) as RepairJson;
+        };
+        expect((await atomFenceRowsCheck(brain, ['default'])).details).toMatchObject({ count: 1 });
+        const preview = (await run([])).results[0]!;
+        expect(preview.listing!.map(row => row.item)).toEqual([`default:${CARRIES_FACT}`]);
+        const hash = preview.apply_command.match(/--expect ([0-9a-f]+)/)![1]!;
+        const applied = (await run(['--apply', '--expect', hash])).results[0]!;
+        await disposePersistenceConsumer(brain);
+        expect(applied.outcomes).toMatchObject({ narrowed: 1 });
+        const [row] = await brain.executeRaw<{ visibility: string }>(
+          `SELECT frontmatter->>'visibility' AS visibility FROM pages WHERE source_id='default' AND slug=$1`, [CARRIES_FACT]);
+        expect(row!.visibility).toBe('private');
+        expect((await atomFenceRowsCheck(brain, ['default'])).status).toBe('ok');
+      }, { databaseUrl: kind === 'postgres' ? requirePostgresTestDatabase() : undefined, setup: async ({ engine: brain }) => {
+        await brain.putPage(ORIGIN, { type: 'note', title: 'Launch review', compiled_truth: WORLD_PAGE_BODY, timeline: '' }, { sourceId: 'default' });
+        await brain.putPage(CARRIES_FACT, { type: 'atom', title: 'renewal-terms', compiled_truth: `Recorded on the page: ${PRIVATE_ROW}.`,
+          frontmatter: { type: 'atom', atom_type: 'insight', source_slug: ORIGIN, source_hash: 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', visibility: 'world', dream_generated: true,
+            managed_extraction: true, extracted_by: 'extract_atoms-v0.41.2.1' } }, { sourceId: 'default' });
+      } });
+    }, 180_000);
+  });
+}

diff --git a/test/sync-restored-file-purge.test.ts b/test/sync-restored-file-purge.test.ts

@@ -0,0 +1,422 @@
+/**
+ * A file a managed sync deleted (its commit removed the file) and Git later put back stays in the brain (GST-2201).
+ *
+ * Protects: when a commit deletes a Markdown file, sync soft-deletes its page; when the same file comes back (a revert, a
+ * branch switch and back, a later commit that re-adds it, with the same or edited bytes), the next sync brings the page
+ * back (same page row) instead of settling it as deleted, so search, get and recall see it again and sync status never
+ * says synced while the page is missing. A brain an older version left in that state heals on its next plain sync. The
+ * retention purge (the cycle purge phase, the purge job and the consented `gbrain pages purge-deleted`) never removes a
+ * file that is committed at the source's last commit or at HEAD: a sync-made tombstone whose file is back waits for the
+ * sync that restores it; a person's delete undone in Git, and a tombstone gbrain can no longer tell was sync-made, are
+ * purged database-only with the file left alone; a person's delete whose file stays gone purges as before.
+ *
+ * PGLite always; Postgres with DATABASE_URL (test/postgres-unit-arms.txt).
+ */
+import { describe, expect, spyOn, test } from 'bun:test';
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
+import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, renameSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join } from 'node:path';
+import type { BrainEngine } from '../src/core/engine.ts';
+import type { OperationContext } from '../src/core/ops/contract.ts';
+import { runCycle } from '../src/core/cycle.ts';
+import { makePurgeHandler } from '../src/core/minions/handlers/purge.ts';
+import { submitPageMutation } from '../src/core/persistence/page-mutations.ts';
+import { performManagedSync } from '../src/core/persistence/sync-run.ts';
+import { readSyncStatus } from '../src/core/persistence/sync-status.ts';
+import { MANAGED_SYNC_PASS_OP } from '../src/core/persistence/sync-pass-row.ts';
+import { SYNC_DELETE_TOMBSTONE_OP } from '../src/core/persistence/sync-delete-tombstones.ts';
+import { declarePersistenceProtocol } from '../src/core/persistence/protocol.ts';
+import { __resetTreeReuseForTests } from '../src/core/persistence/sync-tree-reuse.ts';
+import { runPages } from '../src/commands/pages.ts';
+import { installFaultHook } from '../src/core/persistence/fault-points.ts';
+import { managedBrain, settleManagedGitEffects } from './helpers/managed-brain.ts';

+import { withEnv } from './helpers/with-env.ts';
+
+const git = (root: string, ...args: string[]) => execFileSync('git', ['-C', root, ...args], { encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
+const commit = (root: string, message: string) => { git(root, 'add', '-A'); git(root, '-c', 'user.name=Example', '-c', 'user.email=example@example.invalid', 'commit', '-qm', message); };
+const note = (title: string, body: string) => `---\ntype: concept\ntitle: ${title}\n---\n\n${body}\n`;
+const OPTS = { sourceId: 'default', noPull: true, noEmbed: true, noExtract: true };
+const A = 'notes/doc-a', B = 'notes/doc-b', TWIN = 'notes/twin', COPY = 'notes/twin-copy', USER = 'notes/user', KEEP = 'notes/keep';
+const BODY: Record<string, string> = { [A]: note('Doc A', 'Alice-example wrote about topic a.'), [B]: note('Doc B', 'Notes on acme-example, topic b.'),
+  [TWIN]: note('Twin', 'The same words in two files.'), [COPY]: note('Twin', 'The same words in two files.'), [USER]: note('User', 'A page a person deletes.'),
+  [KEEP]: note('Keep', 'A page nobody touches.') };
+const setup = ({ root }: { root: string }) => {
+  mkdirSync(join(root, 'notes'), { recursive: true }); git(root, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main');
+  for (const [slug, body] of Object.entries(BODY)) writeFileSync(join(root, `${slug}.md`), body);
+  commit(root, 'notes');

+const CONSENT_ENV = { GBRAIN_CONSENT: undefined };
+
+const page = async (engine: BrainEngine, slug: string) => (await engine.executeRaw<{ id: number | string; deleted_at: string | null; compiled_truth: string }>(
+  'SELECT id, deleted_at, compiled_truth FROM pages WHERE source_id=$1 AND slug=$2', ['default', slug]))[0];
+const sync = async (engine: BrainEngine) => { await performManagedSync(engine, OPTS); };
+const status = async (engine: BrainEngine) => { const s = await readSyncStatus(engine, 'default', { detail: false }); return { state: s.state, reason: s.reason }; };
+const removeAndSync = async (engine: BrainEngine, root: string, slugs: string[]) => {
+  git(root, 'rm', '-q', ...slugs.map(slug => `${slug}.md`)); commit(root, 'remove notes');
+  await sync(engine);
+  for (const slug of slugs) expect((await page(engine, slug))?.deleted_at).not.toBeNull();
+};
+/** Ages every tombstone (and its sync-deletion record) by `hours`, as time would. A fixture write, outside coordination. */
+async function age(engine: BrainEngine, hours: number): Promise<void> {
+  await engine.executeRaw('UPDATE persistence_brain SET enabled=false WHERE singleton=1');
+  await engine.executeRaw(`UPDATE pages SET deleted_at = deleted_at - ($1 || ' hours')::interval WHERE source_id='default' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL`, [String(hours)]);
+  await engine.executeRaw(`UPDATE op_checkpoints c SET completed_keys = jsonb_set(c.completed_keys, '{0,deleted_at}', to_jsonb(p.deleted_at)) FROM pages p
+    WHERE c.op=$1 AND p.id::text = c.fingerprint`, [SYNC_DELETE_TOMBSTONE_OP]);
+  await engine.executeRaw('UPDATE persistence_brain SET enabled=true WHERE singleton=1');
+}
+async function cli(engine: BrainEngine, args: string[]): Promise<void> {
+  const log = spyOn(console, 'log').mockImplementation(() => {});
+  const err = spyOn(console, 'error').mockImplementation(() => {});
+  try { await withEnv(CONSENT_ENV, () => runPages(engine, args)); }
+  finally { log.mockRestore(); err.mockRestore(); }
+}
+type Purge = 'cycle phase' | 'purge job' | 'CLI purge-deleted';
+const PURGES: Purge[] = ['cycle phase', 'purge job', 'CLI purge-deleted'];
+async function purge(engine: BrainEngine, root: string, how: Purge): Promise<void> {
+  if (how === 'cycle phase') await withEnv(CONSENT_ENV, () => runCycle(engine, { brainDir: root, phases: ['purge'], sourceId: 'default' }));
+  else if (how === 'purge job') await withEnv(CONSENT_ENV, () => makePurgeHandler(engine)({ data: { scope: 'pages' } } as never));
+  else await cli(engine, ['purge-deleted', '--json', '--yes']);
+}
+/** The file is on disk with its committed bytes and the checkout has no change to it. */
+const fileKept = (root: string, slug: string) => {
+  expect(existsSync(join(root, `${slug}.md`))).toBe(true);
+  expect(readFileSync(join(root, `${slug}.md`), 'utf8')).toBe(BODY[slug]!);
+  expect(git(root, 'status', '--porcelain', '--', `${slug}.md`)).toBe('');
+};
+/** A person deletes `slug` through delete_page; its write-through publication settles. */
+async function personDelete(engine: BrainEngine, ctx: OperationContext, slug: string): Promise<void> {
+  const snapshot = await engine.readPageSnapshot(slug, { sourceId: 'default' });
+  await submitPageMutation(ctx, { operation: 'delete_page', params: { slug, expected_revision: snapshot!.revision, request_id: randomUUID() } });
+  await settleManagedGitEffects(engine);
+  expect((await page(engine, slug))?.deleted_at).not.toBeNull();
+}
+/** Commits the removal the delete left in the checkout, then puts `slug`'s original bytes back in a new commit (an undo in Git). */
+const restoreInGit = (root: string, slug: string) => {
+  if (git(root, 'status', '--porcelain', '--', `${slug}.md`)) commit(root, `remove ${slug}`);
+  writeFileSync(join(root, `${slug}.md`), BODY[slug]!); commit(root, `restore ${slug}`);
+};

+        if (git(root, 'status', '--porcelain', '--', `${USER}.md`)) commit(root, 'remove user note');
+        await sync(engine);
+        await age(engine, 100);
+        await purge(engine, root, how);
+        expect(await page(engine, USER)).toBeUndefined();
+        expect(existsSync(join(root, `${USER}.md`))).toBe(false);
+        expect((await page(engine, KEEP))?.deleted_at).toBeNull();
+      }, { setup, databaseUrl }), 300_000);
+    }
+  });
+}
